descriptionByLocale.fr:
Introduction

Pour notre division Achats, Soutien et Infrastructures, nous recherchons un Space Planner dont la mission principale sera d'élaborer et réaliser des projets d'aménagement administratifs et industriels au sein de l'entreprise.

Responsabilités

• Contacter les clients internes pour analyser et comprendre leurs besoins

• Elaborer les dossiers et les détails d'exécution

• Constituer les estimations des travaux et suivre financièrement les projets

• Planifier et coordonner les travaux

Profil

• Architecte, CFC Dessinateur en bâtiment ou diplôme d'Architecte d'intérieur

• Expérience de plus de 5 ans en matière de conduite de projet d'aménagement et/ou bâtiment.

• Maîtrise du logiciel Archicad (licence 28), de MS Project et de l'environnement PC (suite Windows)

• Proactivité, autonomie et grande attention aux détails

• Sens de la communication et bonnes qualités relationnelles

Conclusion

Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant, d’excellentes conditions de travail, des solutions de flexibilisation du temps de travail et des prestations sociales de premier ordre.

Nous vous remercions d'adresser un dossier de candidature complet (CV, lettre de motivation, certificats et diplômes).

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione

Per il nostro reparto Qualità e Sostenibilità, stiamo cercando un Project Manager (H/F) la cui missione principale sarà quella di condurre progetti attivi su vari tipi (legislativo, sostenibilità, prodotto, edificio) accompagnando team multidisciplinari nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi previsti dalla Direzione.

responsabilità

• Gestione e coordinamento dei progetti di Project Management Office

• Stabilire e monitorare i vari programmi, con particolare attenzione alla tempestività, alle pietre miliari e ai materiali associati

• Comunicazione di supporto e report dei progetti

• Garantire il monitoraggio delle procedure e dei processi (ad esempio la gestione dei rischi) del Gruppo in collaborazione con i vari stakeholder interni ed esterni

• Federare tutti i collaboratori intorno a obiettivi e valore lavoro di squadra

Profilo

• Diploma di formazione professionale superiore - ingegnere HES, tecnico ES o equivalente - completato idealmente con certificazione di gestione del progetto

• Esperienza confermata (minimo 5 anni) nella gestione di complessi progetti industriali (conoscenza di prodotto e ambiente orologiero più)

• Buona capacità di comunicazione, leadership naturale e facilità di relazione

• Autonomo, dinamico, con un senso di responsabilità e una capacità di essere forza di proposta attraverso uno spirito di analisi e di sintesi che consente oggettività e rigore

Conclusioni

Vi offriamo un ambiente stimolante, eccellenti condizioni di lavoro, soluzioni flessibili per il tempo di lavoro e migliori vantaggi sociali.

Grazie per l'invio di un pacchetto completo (CV, lettera di copertura, certificati e diplomi).
descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction

For our Quality & Sustainability department, we are looking for a Project Manager (H/F) whose main mission will be to lead active projects on various types (legislative, sustainability, product, building) by accompanying multidisciplinary teams in achieving the objectives mandated by the Directorate.

Responsibilities

• Managing and coordinating Project Management Office projects

• Establish and monitor the various schedules, with particular attention to timeliness, milestones and associated deliverables

• Support communication and project reporting

• To ensure the monitoring of procedures and processes (e.g. risk management) of the Group in collaboration with the various internal and external stakeholders

• Federate all contributors around goals and value teamwork

Profile

• Higher vocational training diploma - HES engineer, ES technician or equivalent – ideally completed with project management certification

• Confirmed experience (minimum 5 years) in the management of complex industrial projects (knowledge of product and watchmaking environment plus)

• Good communication capacity, natural leadership and relationship ease

• Autonomous, dynamic, with a sense of responsibility and a capacity to be a force of proposal through a spirit of analysis and synthesis allowing objectivity and rigour

Conclusion

We offer you a stimulating environment, excellent working conditions, flexible working time solutions and top social benefits.

Thank you for sending a complete application package (CV, cover letter, certificates and diplomas).
descriptionByLocale.de:
Einleitung

Für unsere Qualitäts- und Nachhaltigkeitsabteilung suchen wir einen Projektmanager (H/F), dessen Hauptaufgabe darin besteht, aktive Projekte verschiedener Art (Gesetzgebung, Nachhaltigkeit, Produkt, Bau) zu leiten, indem wir multidisziplinäre Teams bei der Erreichung der von der Direktion festgelegten Ziele begleiten.

Zuständigkeiten

• Verwaltung und Koordination von Project Management Office Projekten

• Festlegung und Überwachung der verschiedenen Zeitpläne unter besonderer Berücksichtigung der Aktualität, der Meilensteine und der damit verbundenen Ergebnisse

• Unterstützung der Kommunikation und Projektberichterstattung

• Gewährleistung der Überwachung von Abläufen und Prozessen (z.B. Risikomanagement) der Gruppe in Zusammenarbeit mit den verschiedenen internen und externen Stakeholdern

• Föderieren Sie alle Mitwirkenden um Ziele und Wert Teamarbeit

Profil

• Höheres Ausbildungsdiplom - HES-Ingenieur, ES-Ingenieur oder gleichwertig - idealerweise mit Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung abgeschlossen

• Bestätigte Erfahrung (mindestens 5 Jahre) im Management komplexer Industrieprojekte (Kenntnisse der Produkt- und Uhrmacherumgebung plus)

• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit, natürliche Führung und Beziehung Leichtigkeit

• Autonom, dynamisch, mit Verantwortungsbewusstsein und der Fähigkeit, durch einen Geist der Analyse und Synthese eine Vorschlagskraft zu sein, die Objektivität und Strenge ermöglicht

Schlussfolgerung

Wir bieten Ihnen ein anregendes Umfeld, hervorragende Arbeitsbedingungen, flexible Arbeitszeitlösungen und erstklassige Sozialleistungen.

Vielen Dank für die Zusendung eines vollständigen Bewerbungspakets (Lebenslauf, Anschreiben, Zertifikate und Diplome).

Introduction

For our Production division, we are looking for an Operations Sector Manager whose main mission will be to drive a manufacturing sector by guaranteeing the production objectives and the expected level of performance (quality, quantity, costs and deadlines).

Responsibilities

Team Management:

• Communicate global guidelines and set individual objectives

• Support, guide and stimulate employees in achieving their objectives and developing their skills

• Adhering to vision, motivating and valuing team work

• Creating an environment conducive to the smooth running of the activity by promoting communication, generating a climate of trust and contributing to the cohesion of the group

• Develop relationships with interfaces to boost exchanges and sources of progress

Operational management:

• Ensuring the organization of its workshops and ensuring the effectiveness of operational reviews

• Deliver the expected products in accordance with quality requirements, the health of its employees, deadlines and costs

• Contribute to the industrial vision of the service and manage strategic roadmap projects

• Continuously improve work organisation and production flows by anticipating changes and new operational constraints

• Promoting cohesion and cooperation with other business departments and divisions

Profile

• Diploma of engineer HES, EPF, or equivalent

• Experience confirmed in management in an industrial environment

• Experience in change management

• Natural Leadership, Listening and Empathy

• Human contact and communication

• Management Courage and Situational Intelligence

We offer you a stimulating environment, excellent working conditions, flexible working time solutions and top social benefits.

Thank you for sending a complete application package (CV, cover letter, certificates and diplomas).

Description Motivated by an apprenticeship as a Finisher - Numerical Control option? Ready to become a reference in your trade thanks to high-quality training in a leading company? Join us! The watchmaking finisher receives the various parts of a watch once they have been machined. He/she subjects them to a series of finishing operations (polishing, satin-finishing, highlighting, etc.) designed to give their surface the final aesthetic appearance desired by the customer. This profession allows you to tackle precision mechanics as well as aesthetic and dimensional control. After initial manual training, the Numerical Control (NC) orientation allows you to specialize in carrying out operations using automated machines on large volumes. This apprenticeship is suitable for young people who are comfortable in technological and mechanical environments, with a keen eye for detail.
• Profile - Visual acuity and manual dexterity - Concentration and patience - Interest in mechanics, metalworking, and technical drawing - Autonomy - Good spatial representation
• What we offer - You will be guided by experienced trainers - You will be able to evolve in an exceptional working environment - This training will ensure you have excellent prospects - Rolex is committed to offering you more than just an apprenticeship: a real opportunity for personal and professional development Contact - If you are motivated to take on the challenge, do not hesitate to apply - Your application must include: - a curriculum vitae - a letter of motivation - your school reports for the last three years - your EVATech test results - Thank you for registering through the following link: https://eva-evatech.ch/
